intro: 「賴瑞的調酒研究室」是一款以對話與選擇推進的單人文字冒險遊戲。你扮演酒吧主人賴瑞，在證券公司、大學、街道與綠島等場景和不同角色互動，閱讀他與身邊人物的故事。
出現選項時，選擇賴瑞的回應。選擇可能影響角色好感、後續分支與結局；遊戲提供多條角色路線，可用存檔回到先前的段落，再嘗試另一種選擇。
Steam 版提供 40 格本機存檔、快速存檔與快速讀取。完整讀完並達成的結局會自動記錄在「結局蒐集」，可查看各路線的完成進度；尚未達成的結局名稱會保持隱藏。
features: 扮演酒吧主人賴瑞
從賴瑞的角色出發，透過閱讀與選擇探索他和不同人物的關係。
多條路線與多重結局
對話選項可能影響角色好感、劇情分支及結局。
40 格本機存檔
將想保留的路線進度存入不同格，再從指定存檔接續。
快速存檔與快速讀取
用工具列的「快速存檔」保存目前進度，以「快速讀取」返回該次保存的位置。
結局蒐集
已達成的結局自動記錄，依路線查看進度；未達成的結局名稱不會提前顯示。
滑鼠與鍵盤操作
點擊對話框、按 Enter 或空白鍵推進劇情；F11 可切換全螢幕。
八種遊戲語言
支援繁中、英文、日文、韓文、簡中、泰文、德文與西班牙文，可在主畫面切換介面與劇本文字；無角色語音。
stepDetails: 在主畫面選「新開始遊戲」，依畫面提示閱讀故事。你扮演的是酒吧主人賴瑞；點擊對話框、按 Enter 或空白鍵推進對話，認識與他互動的人物。需要重新從頭開始時，可使用工具列的「重新開始」。
遇到對話選項時，選擇你想讓賴瑞採取的回應，接著閱讀角色反應與後續發展。選擇可能影響好感、分支及結局；想比較不同選項，可以先保留這個段落的存檔。
在想保留的段落，使用工具列的「快速存檔」保存目前進度；若要分開保留多條路線，開啟「存檔格」，在「存檔模式」選擇要儲存的位置。共有 40 格，請自行安排想保留的路線與分歧。
使用「快速讀取」，或在「存檔格」切換到「讀取模式」，回到先前保存的位置；主畫面也可選「讀取存檔格」。再嘗試不同回應並繼續閱讀。完整讀完結局後，開啟「結局蒐集」查看已自動記錄的完成進度。
more: 把重要分歧分別存入不同格，確認要保留的進度後再使用其他格或覆寫舊檔，依照想重訪的段落安排 40 個位置。
在主畫面或工具列開啟「結局蒐集」，查看各路線已達成的結局與完成數量。未達成的名稱保持隱藏。
在「設定」調整對話字體大小，或重新查看新手教學。F11 或 Alt+Enter 切換全螢幕，Esc 離開全螢幕。
路線存檔與結局紀錄保存在本機。接續遊玩時，使用快速讀取或指定存檔格返回已保存的段落。
tips: 先完成一條路線，再用重要分歧前的存檔探索其他選擇；不同存檔可能包含不同的前置選擇。
快速存檔適合保存目前進度；想同時保留多段路線時，使用不同的存檔格。重新開始前，先保存還想接續的段落。
不要只停在結局標題：繼續讀完結局，讓劇情進入結局後的段落，再查看「結局蒐集」是否已記錄。

intro: Larry's Mixology Lab is a single-player text adventure driven by dialogue and choices. You play as Larry, a bar owner, interacting with different characters at a securities firm, a university, on city streets and on Green Island.

When choices appear, decide how Larry responds. Choices may affect relationships, later branches and endings. The game has multiple character routes, and saved progress lets you return to an earlier passage and try another choice.

The Steam version provides 40 local save slots, Quick Save and Quick Load. Completed endings are recorded automatically in Endings, where you can review progress for each route. Names of endings you have not reached remain hidden.
features: Play as Larry
Take the role of the bar owner and explore his relationships with different characters through reading and choices.
Multiple routes and endings
Dialogue choices may affect relationships, story branches and endings.
40 local save slots
Keep route progress in separate slots and resume from a chosen save.
Quick Save and Quick Load
Use Quick Save on the toolbar to save your current progress, then Quick Load to return to that saved point.
Ending collection
Completed endings are recorded automatically, with progress shown by route. Names of endings you have not reached stay hidden.
Mouse and keyboard controls
Click the dialogue box or press Enter or Space to advance. Press F11 to toggle fullscreen.
Eight game languages
Choose Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Thai, German or Spanish from the title screen for the interface and story text. Characters are not voiced.
stepDetails: Select New Game on the title screen and follow the on-screen prompts. You play as Larry, the bar owner. Click the dialogue box or press Enter or Space to read on and meet the people he interacts with. To begin again from the start, use Restart on the toolbar.

When dialogue choices appear, decide how you want Larry to respond, then read the other characters’ reactions and what follows. Choices may affect relationships, branches and endings. Save at a passage you want to revisit before comparing different responses.

Use Quick Save on the toolbar to save your current progress. To keep multiple routes separately, open Save Slots and choose a slot in Save Mode. There are 40 slots; decide which routes and branching points you want to keep.

Use Quick Load, or switch Save Slots to Load Mode, to return to an earlier saved point. You can also select Load Game on the title screen. Try a different response and continue reading, then finish the ending and open Endings to check the automatically recorded progress.
more: Keep important branches in separate slots and check which progress you want to retain before using another slot or overwriting a save. Prioritise the passages you want to revisit when organising the 40 available slots.
Open Endings from the title screen or toolbar to review completed endings and counts by route. Unreached ending names remain hidden.
Use Settings to change dialogue text size or revisit the tutorial. F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen; Esc leaves fullscreen.
Route saves and ending records are stored locally. Use Quick Load or a specific save slot to return to previously saved progress.
tips: Finish one route, then use saves from important branches to explore other choices. Different saves may contain different earlier decisions.
Use Quick Save for your current progress and separate save slots for routes you want to retain. Save any progress you want to continue before choosing Restart.
Do not stop at an ending’s title: keep reading through the ending until the story moves to the following section, then check that it has been added to Endings.
